name: Event Cinemas student tickets (Brisbane City, Indooroopilly, Australia Fair)
summary: $11.50 movie tickets for students at Event Cinemas Brisbane City, Indooroopilly and Australia Fair via a Cinebuzz promo code.
key: Students can see films for just $11.50 (online booking fee applies).
who: Students with a valid current student ID card and a free Cinebuzz account.
how: Show your student ID at the cinema to get a promo code.
Add the promo code to your Cinebuzz account online; it can take up to 24 hours to load.
catches: Not valid in Gold Class, Boutique, IMAX, 4DX, ScreenX or premium seating, or for special events.
The page's summary also mentions an $8 Student Monday ticket, which conflicts with the $11.50 offer.

evidence.quote: Offer only valid at Event Cinemas Australia Fair, Brisbane City and Event Cinemas Indooroopilly.
Only valid for single admission with a valid current student ID card and registered Cinebuzz card or barcode.
